objects.name: Analytic 2147
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a browser process on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux workstation spawning child processes that execute with arguments inconsistent with normal browsing, or writing binaries to /tmp or user home directories. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=execve; browser process spawns a command shell, script interpreter, or executable child inconsistent with the approved browser-child baseline

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Inventory of ICS engineering/operator workstations from which routine vendor software downloads occur.
